source_meeting: 2026-08-02 virtual meeting of the eight countries participating in the additional voluntary adjustments
completes: the full rollback of the 1.65 mb/d voluntary cut tranche
note: Six days running I flagged in the daily report that I did not have this split and would not invent one. This file closes that gap. The figures are the SEPTEMBER REQUIRED PRODUCTION levels - quotas, not deliveries. The delivery gap is tracked separately below and is the number that actually matters.

delivery_gap.scope: broader OPEC+ group, not only the eight voluntary-adjustment countries
delivery_gap.interpretation: The shortfall exceeds the total output of every OPEC member except Saudi Arabia and Iraq. Members cannot fill the quotas they already hold, so a +188 kb/d paper increase is an accounting event rather than a supply event.

spare_capacity.assessment: effective group spare capacity collapsed toward near-zero
spare_capacity.detail: Saudi Arabia holds the only meaningful theoretical buffer. Russia, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman all run near capacity.
spare_capacity.caveat: Several secondary sources frame this as 'post-UAE exit'. A UAE departure from OPEC+ is NOT confirmed and is not treated as established here.

forward_guidance: OPEC+ is considering pausing all further increases beyond September 2026; the hiking cycle that began post-closure ends there.
